svg.data-spec:
title: funcd app kind: flow
cli: funcdctl | app deploy @gray check: Admission | each part as if alone @teal app: App | parts, hooks, requires @purple rev: AppRevision | one per changed spec @purple
[Rollout] purple down req: Required Apps | Ready, matching version before: Before hooks | Functions @blue write: Parts written | dropped ones pruned after: After hooks | revision current @blue [/]
[Parts] green fns: Functions wfs: Workflows sites: Sites routes: Routes stores: Stores | KV, Buckets, SQL, Lakes events: Events | EventSources, Sensors config: ConfigMaps [/]
cli > check > app > rev rev > req > before > write > after Rollout > Parts: writes rev ~> app: app rollback
